name: File Zipper Bot
description: High-performance asynchronous Telegram bot for compressing, extracting, downloading, and cloud-uploading files.

API_ID.description: Your Telegram API ID from https://my.telegram.org

API_HASH.description: Your Telegram API Hash from https://my.telegram.org

ADMIN_IDS.description: Comma-separated Telegram user IDs of administrators with access to /broadcast, /stats, /users, /skip, and /reboot

MONGO_URL.description: MongoDB connection URI (optional — leave blank to use in-memory storage that resets on restart)

FORCE_SUBSCRIBE.description: Require users to join support channels before using the bot

MAX_DOWNLOAD_BYTES.description: Maximum allowed download size in bytes per file (default: 2147483648 = 2 GB)

MAX_EXTRACT_BYTES.description: Maximum total uncompressed extraction size in bytes (default: 1073741824 = 1 GB)

MAX_EXTRACT_ENTRIES.description: Maximum number of files allowed in an extracted archive (default: 2000)

MAX_EXTRACT_SECONDS.description: Maximum extraction execution timeout in seconds (default: 600)

NULOADER_API_URL.description: NuLoader API endpoint for uploading files exceeding the 2 GB Telegram limit

NULOADER_API_KEY.description: API key for NuLoader cloud storage upload

NULOADER_EXPIRY_MODE.description: Retention/expiry mode on NuLoader (e.g., days_7, downloads_5)

SEVENZIP_BINARY.description: Absolute path to the 7z executable (optional — only needed if auto-detection fails on an unusual host)
